sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Floral Halo Solitaire CZ Silver-Plated Ring
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Product Description:
Elevate your elegance with the timeless Floral Halo Solitaire CZ Silver-Plated Ring for Women. This dazzling ring features a brilliant round CZ stone embraced by a delicate floral halo, all set on a shimmering silver-plated band for a truly luxurious look. The classic floral motif of the Floral Halo Solitaire CZ Silver-Plated Ring for Women ensures you stand out for daily wear, parties, or as a cherished gift for someone special.
Why You Will Love It:
✨ Romantic floral halo design for feminine charm
✨ Sparkling solitaire and halo for a show-stopping finish
✨ Adjustable fit for comfort and versatility
✨ Ideal accessory for everyday glamour, special occasions, or gifting
Highlights / Specifications:
🔹 Material: Premium-quality, sturdy alloy
🔹 Plating: High-grade silver plating for brilliant shine
🔹 Stone Type: Round-cut cubic zirconia in solitaire & halo setting
🔹 Design: Floral cluster motif with shimmering centerpiece
🔹 Size/Fit: Adjustable to fit most finger sizes
🔹 Best Use: Perfect for daily wear, party wear, and meaningful gifting
Care Instructions:
💎 Clean gently with a microfiber or polishing cloth
🚫 Avoid chemicals, water, and ultrasonic cleaners
🛑 Remove while swimming, showering, or gardening
🌡️ Store in a cool, dry place away from extreme temperatures
Perfect For:
🎁 Gifting on Weddings, Birthdays, Valentine's Day, Festivals
👭 Teen girls, daughters, sisters, and fashion-forward women
💃 Matching with western and ethnic outfits for a glam touch
